primary_endpoint: At 24 weeks: fibrosis improvement (≥1 stage) without worsening of NASH, and NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis.
efficacy_outcome: Fibrosis improvement: 7% with placebo vs. 22%, 26%, and 27% with pegozafermin 15, 30, and 44 mg, respectively; differences were significant for 30 mg (19 percentage points; P=0.009) and 44 mg (20 percentage points; P=0.008), but not 15 mg. NASH resolution: 2% with placebo vs. 37%, 23%, and 26%, respectively; reported 95% CIs for the differences excluded zero at all doses.
safety_signal: Most common adverse events associated with pegozafermin were nausea and diarrhea.
